ANSWER:
Made `create-missing` opt-in everywhere.

Code
- crates/mdbook-core/src/config.rs: `BuildConfig::default()` now has `create_missing: false` (it was `true`), and the field's doc comment says a missing file is an error. Book loading (`load_book` in crates/mdbook-driver/src/load.rs) already checks this flag, so `build`, `serve`, `watch`, `test` and the API all fail on a missing chapter unless the book sets `create-missing = true` (or `MDBOOK_BUILD__CREATE_MISSING=true`). The error is the existing "failed to read chapter ..." one.
- crates/mdbook-driver/src/init.rs: `BookBuilder::build` used to `panic!` if loading the new book failed, on the assumption that this "can't happen". It now can happen: `mdbook init` runs over an existing SUMMARY.md that lists files that aren't there. So it now returns the error with the context "Unable to load the new book". I removed the `error` import it no longer uses.

Tests
- The tests/testsuite/build/create_missing fixture now sets `create-missing = true`.
- New fixture build/missing_file_default, with no `[build]` section, and new test `failure_on_missing_file_by_default`: the build fails and the file is not created.
- tests/testsuite/init.rs: in `init_with_custom_book_and_src_locations`, the expected written book.toml now has `create-missing = false`. `init_from_summary` now opts in through `MDBOOK_BUILD__CREATE_MISSING=true` and runs `init --force`. New test `init_from_summary_without_create_missing` checks that init fails and creates no files.

Docs (guide/src)
- format/configuration/general.md: the example now shows `false`, and the option description now says the default is an error.
- cli/build.md, cli/serve.md, cli/init.md and guide/creating.md no longer say missing files are created automatically. Each now says this only happens with `create-missing`. init.md shows the environment-variable way to opt in, because `init` writes a fresh book.toml.

Things to know
- This is a breaking change in behaviour: books that relied on chapters being created automatically will now fail to build until they add `create-missing = true`. I did not add a CHANGELOG entry, because the changelog is written per release with PR links; you may want to add one there.
- The old docs said `serve` re-creates deleted chapters. That now only happens when the option is enabled.
- I did not compile or run the tests. `cargo check --offline` could not resolve dependencies in this environment.
